description: This file contains ARM assembly code implementing a specialized 4x8 GEMM kernel optimized for AArch32 NEON instructions. It is used within the QNNPACK library for quantized matrix multiplication on platforms with NEON support, likely as part of the PyTorch framework. The code handles loading inputs, applying quantization parameters, performing multiply-accumulate operations, and quantizing/storing the results.

methods.name: pytorch_q8gemm_ukernel_4x8__aarch32_neon
methods.description: The main assembly-implemented function performing quantized GEMM for 4 rows and 8 columns, utilizing ARM NEON instructions for efficiency, loading relevant parameters, performing multiply-accumulate, and storing the quantized output.
